Hana R.: Quick follow-up from the console audit: we have a scatter of terms for the in-app help surface. Nav tooltip says `Assist`, the in-app card header says `Knowledge Center`, and CTAs read `Open docs` in places. New users in study were unsure where tutorials lived. Ethan V.: Noted. Support is seeing the same confusion in tickets. We should land on one canonical name and short variants for UI constraints (e.g., short nav vs full header). Iris (design): Proposal: keep the nav affordance terse as `Assist` (fits the nav space and keyboard shortcut), use `Knowledge Center` as the panel title, and surface `Examples & API` as the secondary subline. This differentiates the brand-y nav text from the descriptive panel title. Marta L.: Analytics currently emits assist_click, knowledge_open, and docs_link_follow. We'll need an event alias layer if we change naming. I can draft mappings and a retro-compatible shim. docs-bot: New doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/knowledge-center-lexicon (author: @Iris (design)) :page_with_curl: Hana R.: Accessibility nit: screen readers read the toggle as just "button" and the panel role is missing. Suggested markup: ```

Knowledge Center: examples and API reference

``` Ethan V.: Cross-link behavior: anchors to docs (e.g., docs.redwood.ai/#batching-tips) open a new tab and don't open the panel. Users expect the panel to deep-link when content is available. Can we attempt an in-app deep-link first, fallback to external otherwise? Iris (design): UX flow I sketched: intercept anchor clicks, call openInPanelIfAvailable(anchor). If panel opens, scroll and highlight heading for 2s; if not, open docs in new tab. Also add a `Back to console` micro-link at the top of the panel to avoid context loss. Marta L.: Implementation plan: add a small helper in the shell: ``` function handleDocAnchorClick(e) {\n const anchor = e.target.hash;\n if (!anchor) return;\n if (featureFlags.knowledgePanel) {\n const success = shell.openKnowledgePanel({anchor});\n analytics.track('knowledge_deeplink', {anchor, mode: success ? 'panel' : 'external'});\n if (success) { e.preventDefault(); }\n }\n} ``` Marta L.: We'll gate behind feature flag + add event aliases mapping assist_click->knowledge_open for 6 weeks. I'll own the migration. Hana R.: Microcopy suggestion: global nav tooltip = `Assist`, panel header = `Knowledge Center`, subline = `Examples & API reference`, in-panel CTA = `Open in panel`, external link CTA = `View full docs`. Keeps labels short where space is limited. Ethan V.: Also recommend a keyboard shortcut hint in the nav tooltip: `Assist (press ? for shortcuts)` so power users discover it. Iris (design): I'll update Figma frames, add the highlight animation, and include the SR-only heading. PR will include the accessibility checklist. Marta L.: I'll add unit tests for deep-link success/fallback, the analytics shim, and an a11y test for aria-expanded. Hana R.: Can someone file a short RFC in #product-ship with owners (copy, infra, analytics) and a proposed rollout (feature flag -> staged enable -> alias window) by Wednesday? Ethan V.: I'll file the RFC and tag @Iris @Marta. Iris (design): noted. Marta L.: noted. Hana R.: Thanks all :thumbsup:
